tasks.analysis: The Industrial Revolution was a defining era in human history, sparking lasting changes in economies and daily life. It reshaped economies worldwide, shifting production from manual labor to mechanical systems, which boosted efficiency and output. Cities expanded rapidly as rural populations moved to industrial centers seeking work. Advancements in transportation and communication accelerated progress, laying the foundation for modern society. These innovations improved access to goods, increased productivity, and connected people across long distances, driving global development in ways that shaped the future. 工业革命是人类历史上具有里程碑意义的时代，给经济与日常生活带来了永久性变革。它重塑了全球经济模式，使生产方式从人工劳作转变为机械化体系，大幅提升了生产效率与产量。农村人口涌入工业城市寻找工作，城市规模随之迅速扩张。交通与通讯技术的进步加快了社会发展节奏，为现代社会奠定基础。各类技术革新丰富了物资供给、提高生产力、拉近地域距离，以深远的方式推动了全球发展，深刻影响了人类未来走向。
